subject: maths
question: A merchant gives an additional discount of 10% on the product after an initial discount of 20% on the listed price. He managed to make a 10% profit by selling the product for ₹54,000. What was the listed price of the product?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Initial discount = 20%

additional discount = 10%

Selling price = Rs54000

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = ( 1-d1/100) × ( 1-d2/100) × M.P.

Where, S.P. = Selling price 

M.P. = Marked price or listed price

d1 and d2 are successive discounts respectively

**CALCULATION:**

Here S.P. = Rs54000 , d1 = 20% and d2 = 10%

⇒ S.P. = ( 1- d1/100) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P.

⇒ 54000 = ( 1 - 20/100 ) × ( 1- 10/100) × M.P.

⇒ 54000 = ( 1-1/5) × ( 1- 1/10) × M.P.

⇒ 54000 = 4/5 × 9/10 × M.P.

⇒ M.P. = Rs75,000

**Hence, the Marked price of the listed price is Rs75,000.**
